input.prompt: Recreate the reference infographic as a crisp, high-resolution, clean vector-style render, keeping the exact same layout: four large circles in the corners (purple top-left, teal top-right, blue bottom-left, green bottom-right) around one white central circle, the same icons, the same colours, and the same text word for word. Render it on a pure flat white background: the space between and around the circles is plain solid white with no coloured tint, no pastel patches, no glow, no gradient halos, no drop shadows and no blur. Text must be sharp, correctly spelled and exactly as follows. Central circle: a gear with a small flowchart icon, heading 'WORKFLOW AUTOMATION' and the line 'Route • Approve • Remind • Track'. Top-left purple circle: icon of a document routed to people, heading 'Route Requests', text 'Automatically route each request to the right person or team.', and small chips 'Employee onboarding | Leave requests' and 'IT & facilities tickets | Customer onboarding'. Top-right teal circle: icon of a checklist with a green tick, heading 'Automate Approvals', text 'Apply approval rules based on amount, department or custom conditions.', and chips 'Purchase/expense approvals | Invoice approval' and 'Compliance reviews | Policy-based approvals'. Bottom-left blue circle: icon of a bell with a clock, heading 'Reminders & Escalations', text 'Send automated reminders and escalate stalled requests.', and a chip 'Keep processes on track and ensure timely approvals.' Bottom-right green circle: icon of a dashboard with a rising bar chart and a clock, heading 'Track & Improve', text 'Monitor request status with dashboards, timestamps and insights. Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve.', and chips 'Gain visibility | Spot delays' and 'Improve efficiency'. Bottom centre between the lower circles: small heading 'CONNECT WITH YOUR SYSTEMS' above four small rounded tiles: a Microsoft 365 icon, a Google icon, a people icon labelled 'HR Systems', a database icon labelled 'Finance Software', and the line 'Seamless integration with the tools you already use.' Square composition, a clear white margin on every side so no circle touches the edge, crisp edges, print-quality detail.
input.negative_prompt: pastel colour patches between circles, tinted background areas, glow, halo, soft gradient background, drop shadow, blur, noise, watermark, misspelled words, garbled letters, missing text, extra text, changed layout, photorealistic, 3D render, dark background, circles cropped at the edge
